title: Amazon API Gateway HTTP API with custom domain to Amazon EventBridge
description: Create an HTTP API endpoint with a custom domain that integrates with EventBridge

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern deploys an API Gateway HTTP API with a custom domain configuration and permissions to publish HTTP requests as an events to EventBridge.
